label: Trouble where South America joins Mexico, around Panama
description: Trouble seen at the isthmus where South America meets Mexico, with Panama named. Given 17 December 2025.

label: A green snake with yellow eyes
description: A green snake with yellow eyes, distinguished by him from the python he saw wrapped around America. Given 17 December 2025 and left uninterpreted.

label: The number 25, black with a metallic outline
description: A large black number 25 with a metallic outline seen twice in December 2025, which he says he cannot read and wonders may be a banknote.

label: A python constricting America from the Gulf
description: A massive snake, perhaps a thousand miles from the Gulf to Canada, coming up out of the Gulf and wrapping around the nation, pulling tight with ripples like curtain folds, so it cannot breathe. Seen from December 2025 and tied to the call, who will intercede for America.

label: Great floods all at one time in Thailand
description: Mega floods seen arriving all at one time in Thailand and the surrounding region. Given 15 December 2025.

label: Venezuela burns its own oil fields
description: The Venezuelan leader setting the oil wells on fire so that America cannot take them, explicitly compared to Saddam Hussein in Iraq, with invasion described as a last resort. Given 12 December 2025.
